component.name: reG2
component.summary: GTA2 built from source, played with your own game files

description.p: reG2 runs Grand Theft Auto 2 (1999) natively, from gta2_re, a decompilation that rebuilds the original game's code, with SDL 3, OpenGL and OpenAL Soft.

The game's files are not included. You need your own copy of GTA2 for Windows: the original CD, or the version Rockstar Games gave away in 2004 in its "Rockstar Classics" series. On the first start, choose your GTA2 folder, its installer or a disc image: the game's data is copied into the application's own folder.
This project is not affiliated with or endorsed by Rockstar Games or Take-Two Interactive.
